author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices a rocking steady beat, high and low, stop and go, and playing together, using a giggly nonsense rhyme about a jumping cow.

classes.title: Rock with the cat
classes.goal: Hear the whole silly song and rock to its swingy beat together.

mathTarget.parentLine: A rocking beat that comes back again and again

classes.parentPrompt: Hold your child on your lap and rock forward and back on each big beat.
classes.childAction: Rock and pat your knees with the swingy song.
classes.bridge: The beat rocks like a rocking chair: forward, back, forward, back.

intro.caption: A silly song is coming!
intro.parentCue: child on your lap, rock forward and back

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: feeling the rocking beat, together.

classes.title: Fiddle taps
classes.goal: Tap one steady tap on each big beat while the grown-up plays the tune.

mathTarget.parentLine: One tap for each big beat, no more and no less

classes.parentPrompt: Rest your hand over your child's hand and tap together, then slowly let go.
classes.childAction: Tap any key on every big rocking beat.
classes.bridge: Hey did-dle, did-dle: the taps land on 'hey' and on 'did'.

intro.caption: Tap where the song rocks
intro.parentCue: tap your child's shoulder on each big beat

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: one tap for each big beat.

classes.title: Bear low, bird high
classes.goal: Hear low and high sounds and tap the matching side of the piano.

mathTarget.parentLine: Sounds can climb up, like the cow jumping over the moon

classes.parentPrompt: Growl and crouch for the bear; flap your arms and reach up for the bird.
classes.childAction: Bear sound: tap the left side. Bird sound: tap the right.
classes.bridge: Low sounds stay on the ground with the bear; high sounds reach the moon.

intro.caption: The bear lives low, the bird flies high
intro.parentCue: point left for the bear, right for the bird

games.caption: The cow jumps up high!
games.parentCue: Lift your child's arms up as it climbs

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing high and low sounds.

classes.title: Loud cow, quiet cat
classes.goal: Tap the beat with big loud taps, then with tiny soft taps.

mathTarget.parentLine: The same tap can be big or small

classes.parentPrompt: Use strong arms for loud taps; whisper and tiptoe your fingers for soft.
classes.childAction: Loud: big cow stomps. Soft: tiny cat paws.
classes.bridge: Loud taps are a cow stomping; soft taps are a cat tiptoeing.

intro.caption: Big cow, little cat
intro.parentCue: loud means strong arms, never banging

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing loud and soft.

classes.title: Turtle and bunny rock
classes.goal: Follow the music as it slows like a turtle and speeds like a bunny.

mathTarget.parentLine: The same tune, only the speed changes

classes.parentPrompt: Rock your child slowly, then quickly, matching the music.
classes.childAction: Turtle music: slow taps. Bunny music: quick taps.
classes.bridge: Slow taps are turtle steps; quick taps are the dish running away.

intro.caption: Turtle time, then bunny time
intro.parentCue: slow down if the taps get wild

games.caption: Bunny rocks fast!
games.parentCue: Same tune, now quick and light

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: following slow and fast music.

classes.title: Run, dish! Stop, spoon!
classes.goal: Tap while the music plays and hold still when it stops.

mathTarget.parentLine: When the sound stops, the hands stop too

classes.parentPrompt: Freeze with a funny face when the music stops; giggle when it starts again.
classes.childAction: Tap while the music plays. Freeze when it stops.
classes.bridge: Music on, the dish runs; music off, the dish and spoon hide still.

intro.caption: Tap, tap... freeze!
intro.parentCue: make freezing silly, like a statue

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: listening for stop and go.

classes.title: Cat and fiddle duet
classes.goal: Make the song together: the grown-up plays the tune, the child keeps the beat.

mathTarget.parentLine: Two different jobs fit together into one song

classes.parentPrompt: Play the tune and watch your child; if they stop, keep playing and smile.
classes.childAction: Tap the big beat on any key while your grown-up plays.
classes.bridge: The grown-up is the fiddle; you are the cat tapping along.

intro.caption: I play, you tap
intro.parentCue: sit side by side at the piano

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing one song together, two jobs.

classes.title: Concert for teddy
classes.goal: Play the whole song from the first note to the last, then bow together.

mathTarget.parentLine: A song starts, goes on, and ends; we finish together

classes.parentPrompt: Sit teddy as the audience; play the tune, then laugh, cheer and bow together.
classes.childAction: Tap the beat to the very end, then take a big bow.
classes.bridge: When the dish runs away with the spoon, the song is done: bow!

intro.caption: A song for teddy!
intro.parentCue: sit teddy in front as the audience

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a whole song, start to end.
